rawContent: Just experienced something v triggering. Realised it’s almost exactly 17 years since I was raped in Rio. Realised this as my husband flicked on TV to see Brazil play. Realised simultaneously man who raped me is back in position of power #metoo #mentalhealth

I wish my 27 year old self knew she was not to blame and that years later her 45 year old self would find the words to share her experience of #metoo and #mentalhealth in the hopes others won’t suffer in silence - through this poem
